summary: Large gravel car park off Brisbane Corso with no homes near and cars parked.
reasons: Big gravel lot, wide open entry
No dwellings; park and treatment works
Many cars and some vans parked

best_section.where: Gravel car park south of Brisbane Corso, by the grassed islands

drivers.seclusion: River park to the north across the road; sewage works behind; no dwellings in view.
drivers.access_and_room: Open gravel with a wide mouth onto the Corso; room for many vehicles.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial beside it, but the lot stands clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Seven or so cars parked in a row; two white vans or caravans on the grass edge.

flags: Low-lying: about 6 m, near the Brisbane River
Treatment plant next door, possible odour
sun_shade: Open gravel in full sun; tree shade to the south and east in the morning and afternoon.
cannot_judge: Parking time limits or signs on site
